notes.title: Devlog: Map
notes.content:
Development continues and now I'm ready to show parts of the game map.

 Approximate ratio of map scale of the demo version and the main game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/ead4c8b6f16d2267b472b76b53205f8392eb1963.png

 As before, the map consists of several biomes - forests, fields, swamps. The wasteland biome has been added to them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/62265d41ebe63b9d5f2906021f05729ee2677e94.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/5fbcff6e76e775232856826ae306f8362b3d73b3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/7ffbbc0ba5290481cca2220d73a53efe9cdfdf45.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/0c023245b59503b889826cb5e6b548b1f64cba97.jpg

 There will be several points of interest on the map with their own loot list and enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/bf7f4d61dd0d93f67559740e96d494111c3d45fb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/a859c832ed573e1092b4c8072e97a4d9aa75f9e4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/184a8d1bcd661c394eb9266a55825669a01f691d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/c34d79cf85e51ca18af20a6e0c1255ea7f8dcf28.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/b13f83b688a8b99d8d8b85fd40362391d13f2e4d.jpg

 Some areas will have a high radioactive and toxic background, and it will be possible to enter there safely only with special equipment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/1ee12941397e802144e89382558ec2d8e54fd4f1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/af841aa21f18b6576b6a61039101355ad508dd22.jpg

 The entire map is divided into locations. It is possible to move from one location to another from certain sectors on the border of the location. Also, the game will have guides who can quickly and relatively safely guide the player from one location to another for a fee.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.23
notes.content:
- Added the option to rest for 5 minutes
- Updatied merchants' goods and amount of money
- Slight acceleration of the combat process
- Reduced the cost of using the kitchen to 100 rubles
- New items and recipes
- Added the option of extracting wood with a machete
- Added numerical value of skill and stat progress on the character screen
- Combat mechanics with no limit on the number of attacks
- Added the probability of finding shell casings on the ground after a gun battle
- Reduced animation time of some actions
- Updated game interface and notifications

Old saves will not work, you need to start a new game

notes.title: Demo Update - Changelog
notes.content:
- Added tooltips over items in inventories. The mode can be switched using the button in the inventory interface or the Shift key.
- Added the possibility of autosave when quitting the game. Along with this feature, the game has received a few more changes, so old saves will not work.
- Added a character statistics screen. To open it, you need to go to the journal and select the statistics tab.
- Added recipes for crafting.
- As well as small changes regarding the interface and quests.

notes.title: In-game events
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/49f7b2cf76e3c6879bfd33c883ec6580de1fa398.jpg

During the course of the game, an event may start that changes the conditions of the game or makes it more difficult.


 Solar flare Exposure to radiation throughout the location except for safe or underground structures. 

Toxic precipitation If it starts raining during the event, a player with insufficient protection against toxins will start getting poisoned.

 Eclipse Reduced natural light and consequently more difficult searches.

 Aggressive animals Increased chance of animal attacks, in places where they may be.

 Gang activity Increased chance of ambush or encounter with raiders.

 Cold snap A sudden drop in temperature. Warm clothes or warming up by the fire will help prevent frostbite.

The duration and power of an event can have different meanings.

notes.title: Enemies
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/971bdde4c2f26fe58929413b22f35fb0760cbe47.jpg
A few enemies/monsters/mutants from the game.

 Enemies and monsters vary in their amount of hp, damage, armour and accuracy.
 Loot from enemies is not random, but based on their weapons and equipment.
 Carcasses of animals and mutants can be butchered. People and mushroomers (zombie analogue) can be searched.
 Activity of certain enemies depends on the time of day.
 Spiders can poison a character when attacking, and wolves can cause bleeding.
 Monsters have different probabilities of detecting a character. Some react more to the visibility of the character, while others react to the amount of noise they make.

notes.title: Melee weapons
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/276c83b66a278db331659201cd32a3abc5eef10a.png

Melee weapons have less damage than firearms, but require less action points to attack.

 Food. Cooked food gives more bonuses, but takes time and effort.
  Dismantling. Some items can be disassembled into components.

notes.title: Ruinlander firearms list
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/25f5c32432dda865b41f3d7c92dfcd2f2b71645a.png

Game development is underway and now I am ready to show the weapons presented in the game.


 Parameters.  Each weapon has a value for damage, accuracy, weight, and cost.

 Action points.  Action points required for a shot (single, aiming or burst) vary greatly depending on the type of weapon.

 Rarity.  Rarity affects how often weapons and ammo will be found during a search or appear at vendors. Some weapons can only be obtained by completing quests or with a certain faction reputation.

  Ammunition. Weapon uses only cartridges corresponding to its caliber.
